body: 2026-10-16. Raw token values are stored only in ~/.agx/tokens.yaml (0600 in a 0700 dir; agx refuses a file readable by others) and are rejected if found in config.yaml. Why: config.yaml stays safe to sync or share; one enforced place for secrets. `agx doctor` warns if tokens.yaml sits inside a git work tree. A config.yaml created by `login add` is 0600. Code: login/tokens.go, config/logins.go.
title: Logins D4: raw tokens live only in ~/.agx/tokens.yaml (0600)
